            if (currentLength > maxLength)

            insideParentheses = true;
            if (currentLength > maxLength)
                maxLength = currentLength;
            currentLength = 0;
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            insideParentheses = false;
            previousWasLetter = false;
            if (currentLength > maxLength)
                maxLength = currentLength;
            currentLength = 0;
        }
    }
    std::cout << maxLength << " " << underscoreCount << std::endl;
